    time_until_lunch = (datetime.combine(meeting_end_time.date(), lunch_time.time()) - meeting_end_time).total_seconds() / 3600

    # Convert the time until lunch to 'HH:MM' format
    hours = int(time_until_lunch)
    minutes = int((time_until_lunch - hours) * 60)
    time_until_lunch_str = f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}"

    print(time_until_lunch_str)
